reviewer: portfolio — independent visible-output editorial and cross-set review

method.scope: Only six raw briefs, anonymous packet/protocol and listed images. No prompts, plans, hidden mappings, versions, generation history or peer reports consulted.
method.viewing_sequence: For each listed image: width720 usage, native, long-edge320 thumbnail. Each view was displayed with view_image detail original.
method.copy_method: Direct pixel transcription with explicit usage readings for deadline/full URL; then required-copy cross-check. Punctuation/space observations are not Unicode-byte verification.
method.scoring: Seven separate 1–5 dimensions with located evidence. No composite total, averaging or assumed pair winner.
method.ratio_method: Native dimensions supplied by anonymous packet compared with its target ratio; relative error below1% for all17.
method.no_authorship_claim: AI-slop dimension rates visible editorial specificity and finish, never the identity or process of the maker.
method.linked_reference_limit: The protocol links art-direction.md, but activation allowed only packet/protocol and anonymous images; that unprovided linked file was not read. The complete seven-dimension rubric supplied in the protocol was applied.
